line: A clear thought arrives on the bus today. Save it as a voice note before it drifts.
Someone lightens your Friday. Let them take one task; lunch is on you.
Friday runs hot for you. Finish the must-do, then leave the laptop at work.
People respect your calm today. Lead the meeting; keep it to thirty minutes.
A good deal finds you today. Grab it, but check the return policy.
Patient money wins today. Move a little into savings before the weekend.
Friday fun is yours today. Pick the karaoke song you secretly love.
Your words are clever today. Write the toast, the card or the caption now.
Your crowd flows together today. Say yes to the last-minute dinner.
Someone talks faster today. Let them; your one good line lands later.
